THREE-LANES-NOT-TWO (added 2026-08-12): work here runs in one of three lanes. RESEARCH = the engine (run-workflow.js, 7 templates, Phase-30 citation gate) — the only lane whose output is SELLABLE under the Zero-Fabrication Guarantee. ANALYST = a Claude session using plugin/connector tools to answer what no template covers: pre-sale scoping, feasibility, founder conversations, competitive orientation. NOT citation-gated. BUSINESS = mail/marketing/security, out of the engine entirely. This doctrine previously named only RESEARCH and BUSINESS, so every tool serving the analyst lane scored zero against an engine-only test — which is why bio-research and data were nearly dropped in error.

ANALYST-LANE-PROMOTION-RULE: analyst-lane output is NOT covered by the Zero-Fabrication Guarantee or the Citation-Audit SLA. It ships in exactly two forms: (a) internal / pre-sale material LABELLED as not citation-gated, or (b) a question reshaped into a template run so the engine produces the deliverable and the gate signs it — the analyst work becomes the scoping, not the product. Stating which one it is is mandatory; silence is what turns preliminary work into an overclaim.

BUSINESS-LANE-STAYS-OUT-OF-PREFETCH: no plugin MCP server is injected into config/tool-prefetch-map.json. They return non-citable payloads that dilute the grounded-citation ratio and inflate a token budget already at ~300K/template.
SECURITY-IS-PROPOSE-ONLY: any plugin skill that drifts into security work hands off to the security-orchestration skill. Never weaken Falcon Custom-IOA rule 1.

HTTPS-ONLY: anything engineering:* designs or reviews that binds a TCP host:port must be HTTPS with no plaintext fallback (repo CLAUDE.md invariant; gate: scripts/lint-transport-monorepo.sh --strict).
LOCAL-ONLY-GIT: there is no git remote and no hosted CI. Skills must not assume PRs, branch protection, or a CI pipeline.
ARTIFACT-PLACEMENT: session artifacts to .archive/; engine run artifacts to workspace/audit/; security artifacts to ~/Security Everything (never the monorepo).

oauth_posture.why_no_redirect: The operator asked whether the engineering plugin could be pointed at the YubiKey-gated host GitHub MCP instead of the one it ships. It cannot, and the reason is structural: plugin MCP servers are namespaced `mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__*` while host servers are `mcp__<server>__*`, so a host server NEVER shadows a same-named plugin server — they coexist as separate surfaces. There is no alias, redirect, or override mechanism. Editing the plugin's .mcp.json is not an option either: the package is session-scoped and cloud-synced (see why_repo_owned). So the enforceable posture is: leave the plugin's github server unauthenticated, DENY its tools in ~/.claude/settings.json, and keep the host wrapper as the only GitHub path. No capability is lost — this monorepo is local-only with no git remote (~~source control), and the engineering plugin's value is its SKILLS, which need no MCP server at all.
